ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT (this“Agreement"),made as of the [2 7 ] day of  [Jaauay ] 2026, by and between by and between 735 Arm LLC, having an address at 23 Julianna Place, Apt. #4, Brooklyn, NY 11249 ("Owner") and 170 Arm LLC, having an address at 23 Julianna Place, Apt. #4, Brooklyn, NY 11249 ("Developer")(Owner and Developer are sometimes hereinafter collectively referred to as the “Parties"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Brooklyn and County of Kings, City and State of New York, being Lot 21 in Block 3551 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, as more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Owner Land"; the buildings and improvements located thereon or which may be located thereon in the future are herein referred to as the “Owner Building"; and the Owner Land and the Owner Building are herein collectively referred to as the"OwnerParcel"); WHEREAS,Developer is the owner in fee of certainland,with thebuildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Brooklyn and County of Kings, City and State of New York, being Lot 131 in Block 3551 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, as more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Developer Land”, said building and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof permitted in accordance with this Agreement, being herein collectively called the “Developer Building,” and the Developer Land and the Developer Building being herein collectively called the “Developer Parcel"); WHEREAS, Developer intends to alter and/or construct one or more new buildings on all or a portion of the Developer Land (each, a “New Developer Building"), with a bulk that would be in excess of the bulk permitted to be constructed on Developer Land under the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), if the Developer Land was considered as a separate and independent zoning lot; WHEREAS, Owner intends to alter and/or construct one or more new buildings on all or a portion of the Owner Land (each, a “New Owner Building"), with a bulk that would be in excess of the bulk permitted to be constructed on Developer Land under the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), if the Developer Land was considered as a separate and independent zoning lot; WHEREAS, there are certain “Development Rights” (as hereinafter defined) appurtenant to the Owner Land that are in excess of the“Owner Retained Development Rights" (as hereinafter defined) and that are available for transfer in accordance with the Zoning Resolution;
